audience: sales teams that keep contacts, tasks and opportunities in Wobaka

useCases.title: Review contacts and their owners
useCases.text: List active contacts, filtered by search text, status, owner or tags. Open one contact to read its custom attributes and related contacts.

useCases.title: Check open tasks for a team member
useCases.text: List the open tasks, filtered by assignee or search text. List the members first to get the id of each person.

useCases.title: Read a contact's history before a call
useCases.text: Read the feed of a contact, with its notes, messages and emails. Then list its notes and tasks.

useCases.title: Log a note and a follow-up task
useCases.text: Add a note to a contact. Then create a task for a company member, linked to that contact.

useCases.title: Create a contact and an opportunity
useCases.text: Create a contact, then create an opportunity on it in a pipeline stage. Use a stage id from the pipeline list, not a pipeline id.

useCases.title: Move an opportunity to another stage
useCases.text: List the pipelines and their stages in order. Then move an opportunity to another stage, or mark it lost.
